name: Agent Playground Learning Path
description: How visitors move through the six stages of the learning path. Page views from the browser app 1117825756 (GitHub Pages and browser.nru.to), without the hourly synthetic journey (demoUser = Synthetic check). Stage pages match PAGES in site.js.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT uniqueCount(session) AS 'Sessions', count(*) AS 'Page views' FROM PageView WHERE appId = 1117825756 AND (demoUser IS NULL OR demoUser != 'Synthetic check') SINCE 1 week ago

widgets.title: Sessions reaching each stage, in order

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT funnel(session, WHERE pageUrl LIKE '%/install.html' AS '1. Start here', WHERE (pageUrl LIKE '%/vitals.html' OR pageUrl LIKE '%/errors.html' OR pageUrl LIKE '%/frustration.html') AS '2. What you get for free', WHERE (pageUrl LIKE '%/logs.html' OR pageUrl LIKE '%/events.html' OR pageUrl LIKE '%/measures.html') AS '3. What you add', WHERE (pageUrl LIKE '%/tracing.html' OR pageUrl LIKE '%/websockets.html') AS '4. Follow the network', WHERE pageUrl LIKE '%/spa.html' AS '5. Single-page apps', WHERE pageUrl LIKE '%/replay.html' AS '6. Privacy') FROM PageView WHERE appId = 1117825756 AND (demoUser IS NULL OR demoUser != 'Synthetic check') SINCE 1 week ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'Page views' FROM PageView WHERE appId = 1117825756 AND (demoUser IS NULL OR demoUser != 'Synthetic check') FACET pageUrl SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) AS 'Sessions' FROM (SELECT latest(pageUrl) AS 'lastPage' FROM PageView WHERE appId = 1117825756 AND (demoUser IS NULL OR demoUser != 'Synthetic check') FACET session LIMIT MAX) FACET lastPage SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT 20
